recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with a 1960s aesthetic, featuring a soft gray background and elegant, white serif typography. The subject is posed with her hand to her face, wearing dark clothing with textured, striped cuff details.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subject against a neutral mid-tone gray background
White display typography centered at the top for maximum legibility
Right-aligned tracklist balancing the visual weight of the subject's pose
Strong directional lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on the face
coreInvariants: Heavy winged eyeliner and 1960s hair styling

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale central bust portrait, slightly offset to the left to accommodate the hand pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white of the hand/cuff.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the centered title, moves down to the eyes, follows the hand to the textured cuff, and ends at the tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample gray space at the top and right side to provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone gray background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the subject's hair and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography and highlights on the skin and jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Transitional serif with high stroke contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and styles (Italic for title, Roman for list).
graphicDevices: Subtle grain texture across the whole image
Small square logo box in the top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant transitional serif structure.
Provides the classic, sophisticated 1960s editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with 1960s hair and makeup, posed with her hand to her cheek. The background should be a smooth, medium-gray gradient. The subject should wear a dark sweater with a white-striped cuff.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in white italicized serif font at the top. Add a right-aligned list of text in a smaller, lighter weight of the same serif font on the right side of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the title centered and in an italicized serif?
Does the lighting create a clear distinction between the subject and the gray background?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast edges on the subject
Ensure text is crisp and legible against the gray
Verify the 1960s aesthetic in hair and makeup
Confirm the right-aligned text block is balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W portrait with a mid-tone gray background and elegant white transitional serif typography placed in the negative space.
